name: tana-tasks
description: Tana companion: an outliner over your Tana documents, kept live over Tana's platform sync

scripts.check: node scripts/db-check.js && node scripts/sdk-check.js && node scripts/renderer-check.js && node scripts/renderer-behavior-check.js && node scripts/updater-check.js
scripts.postinstall: plutil -replace CFBundleName -string 'Tana Companion' node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Info.plist && plutil -replace CFBundleDisplayName -string 'Tana Companion' node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app/Contents/Info.plist || true
